final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS tref, tr.tradekind AS ttype, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anly FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS overall FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.tref, s1.ttype, s1.avg_anly, s1.avg_anly - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avg_anly > s2.overall), s4 AS (SELECT ttype, AVG(avg_anly) AS m3, AVG(diff) AS m4 FROM s3 GROUP BY ttype), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(m3) AS grand FROM s4) SELECT s4.ttype, s4.m3, s4.m4, s4.m3 / s5.grand FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.grand IS NOT NULL
